title: Climb Bio to Present at William Blair’s Upcoming Conference Event on Transforming Autoimmune Diseases by Targeting CD19
description: Climb Bio, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, will present and host investor meetings at William Blair's event on transforming autoimmune diseases by targeting CD19. Climb Bio's lead product candidate, budoprutug, is an anti-CD19 monoclonal antibody that has demonstrated B-cell depletion and has potential to treat a broad range of B-cell mediated diseases.

title: Climb Bio Announces Abstract Selected for Presentation at the American Society of Nephrology Kidney Week 2024
description: Climb Bio, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, announced that it will present data on its lead product candidate, budoprutug, an anti-CD19 monoclonal antibody, at the American Society of Nephrology Kidney Week 2024 conference.
